title: AARO briefing: 'AI, quantum, and the Grusch stuff'
summary: Matthew Pines tells of AARO briefing: 'AI, quantum, and the Grusch stuff', about c. 2023 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: it and they said, um, you know, it's a triangle, AI, quantum, and the grush stuff.
speaking to some like CIA guy and the CIA guy was like you know it's a triangle AI quantum and the grush stuff.
tellings.difference: Jesse Michels says the remark came from a CIA man rather than an AARO briefing.
tellings.link_reason: The same remark that it is a triangle of AI, quantum and the Grusch material, credited to Matthew Pines.

as_told.title: CIA source: the AI, quantum and Grusch triangle

tellings.quote: I interviewed a guy named Matthew Pines he's pretty connected in the kind of National Security world and he said that you know somebody in a very cleared to a lot of things I think at the Pentagon said something like AI Quantum plus the grush stuff

as_told.title: RAND contact tracking convergence of quantum, AI and Grusch UFO claims

plain: A guest named Matthew Pines, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2024, says that around 2023 someone in a briefing tied to AARO, the Pentagon's office for looking into unidentified objects, summed up the big picture as "a triangle: AI, quantum, and the Grusch stuff". That means artificial intelligence, quantum technology, and the claims of David Grusch, a witness who says he testified under oath about secret programmes that hold recovered craft. If true, it would suggest that insiders see the three as linked, though when Michels repeated the remark later he said it came from a CIA man rather than from a briefing.
